title: Retire or theme-align text_styles.dart's AppTextStyles, which hardcodes Roboto and diverges from AppTheme's Plus Jakarta Sans
rule: Fowler duplication / dead code (no direct rule ID)

evidence.quote: // NOTE: 'Noto Sans Hebrew' font files must be placed in assets/fonts/ and

why: AppTheme.textTheme (the app's real Material typography, wired into every themed widget via Theme.of(context)) uses GoogleFonts Plus Jakarta Sans; AppTextStyles is a second, parallel static typography table hardcoding 'Roboto' with no colour/brightness awareness. It is consumed directly (bypassing Theme) by lib/features/content_browsing/presentation/screens/text_display_screen.dart — a churn-hotspot screen — at 6 call sites, meaning that screen's text visibly renders in a different typeface family than the rest of the themed app. 'Roboto' also isn't a bundled font asset (only Noto Sans Hebrew is declared in pubspec.yaml), so the family isn't even guaranteed cross-platform (no Roboto on iOS). The file's own comment claiming the Hebrew font 'must be placed in assets/fonts/... until then' is stale — pubspec.yaml:211-222 already bundles all 5 Noto Sans Hebrew weights. getTextDirection/getStyleForContent (lines 146-164) have zero callers anywhere outside their own test file.
recommendation: Either retire AppTextStyles in favour of Theme.of(context).textTheme at its 2 call sites, or derive it from the active theme/GoogleFonts.plusJakartaSans* instead of a hardcoded 'Roboto' literal so the two systems can't drift further; delete the 2 dead helper methods or wire them to a real caller; fix the stale font-availability comment.
acceptance_criteria: text_display_screen.dart and hebrew_text.dart render with the same font family as the rest of the themed app (Plus Jakarta Sans), verified by a widget test reading the resolved TextStyle.fontFamily.
getTextDirection/getStyleForContent removed (with their now-orphaned tests) or given a real caller.
Stale asset-bundling comment corrected or removed.
